name: Shipped features help
description: Help mode entries (help@1) for the Shipped features page.
author: Brett

entries.title: Shipped features
entries.text: Every feature of AmberX-AXF and axHub in one list, from the moment a build plans it to when it went live, with every later change as an edit. Tap a row to see what you said, the builds and PRs behind it, and its edits.

entries.title: View by
entries.text: Groups the list by pull request, build, day, app, plugin, feature type or repo, or shows it flat. The counts on each group follow your filters.

entries.title: Quick filters
entries.text: Hide completed hides Merged, Live and Removed; Hide pending hides Planned, Queued, Building and In PR; tap status chips to show only those. Has edits and Being edited now narrow to changed features. This phone or computer remembers your choice.

entries.title: Sync and export
entries.text: Sync picks up new build events, merged PRs and deploys right away (it also runs by itself every couple of minutes). CSV and Markdown save the rows you see.

entries.title: Shipped features settings
entries.text: Install, uninstall or rebuild the Shipped features ledger (a SQLite file in the console's data folder).

entries.title: Hide completed
entries.text: Turns “Hide completed” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of Shipped features.

entries.title: Hide pending
entries.text: Turns “Hide pending” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of Shipped features.

entries.title: Show cancelled
entries.text: Turns “Show cancelled” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of Shipped features.

entries.title: Has edits
entries.text: Turns “Has edits” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of Shipped features.

entries.title: Being edited now
entries.text: Turns “Being edited now” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of Shipped features.

entries.title: Edit status
entries.text: Where you set “Edit status”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Shipped features.

entries.title: Type
entries.text: The “Type” column. Tap its header to sort the list by it.

steps.say: This is every feature we've planned or shipped. New builds show up here as Planned the moment they're created.
Status shows where each one is: Planned, Queued, Building, In PR, Merged, Live. A tilde means the date was reconstructed from history.
Open a row for what you said, the PRs, and the Edits timeline: every later change to that feature, newest first.
